title: ExPecto
lead: ExPecto predicts how variants change gene expression across more than 200 tissues, by gene, by your own variant file, or by rsID.

pairs.caption: PTEN's predicted expression effects by tissue system

differences.existing: A ? icon on each tab shows a tooltip, such as "Query ExPecto using custom variants"
differences.proposed: No tab tooltips; a one-line summary sits under the title

differences.existing: Search, IRGM and CCR1 examples, then three illustrated sections: deep learning model, cell-type-specific expression, disease-risk variants
differences.proposed: Same search and examples, with an About panel and example file beside it; no illustrated sections

differences.existing: example.vcf and example_strand.vcf in an Example files box inside the form, with Format rules
differences.proposed: example.vcf only, in the side panel; rules sit in a VCF rules accordion
differences.evidence: Capture pair 1. Ask: does ExPecto need example_strand.vcf, or is strand only for Seqweaver?

differences.existing: Submit button; no check seen before sending
differences.proposed: The file is checked in the browser. Run stays off until it is valid and names the count, such as Run ExPecto on 12 variants. Limit is 20,000 variants

differences.existing: A signup checkbox (name signup) is in the form but was not visible
differences.proposed: No signup option
differences.evidence: DOM of humanbase.io/expecto?tabId=3. Ask: when does it show, and should the form keep it?

differences.existing: Lists all 85,312 variants, 20 a page, with pagination
differences.proposed: Shows the search, examples and the live total only; no list until you search

differences.existing: Six columns: CHR, POSITION, RSID, GENE, REFRENCE ALLELE, ALTERNATIVE ALLELE; all results on paged lists
differences.proposed: Four columns: Position, rsID, Gene, Change (G>A); first 10, then Show 7 more. IRGM gives 17 on both

differences.existing: First asks the API with rsid__isempty=False, then without it
differences.proposed: Never sends rsid__isempty
differences.evidence: Network requests on both sides. Ask: should variants with no rsID be hidden?

differences.existing: Symbol, name and a link menu: Ensembl, Entrez, MIM, HGNC
differences.proposed: Symbol, plus Name, Genome, Positions (65 near the start) and Tissue systems (16); no outside links
differences.evidence: Capture pair 2; link menu opened on humanbase.io/expecto/gene/5728

differences.existing: Radio buttons: Tissue System overview, Choose tissue system and tissue
differences.proposed: Segmented control: Tissue systems, Tissues

differences.existing: Resources and Tissue Systems are checkbox menus, so several can be picked at once
differences.proposed: Resource and Tissue system are single-choice menus, plus a new Find a tissue field
differences.evidence: Opened both menus on humanbase.io; GeneExpression.tsx Select

differences.existing: Clicking a tissue system, such as nervous system, opens just its tissues (Tissue Systems: 1 of 16)
differences.proposed: Row labels are plain text
differences.evidence: Clicked nervous system on humanbase.io; proposed URL and view did not change

differences.existing: In the overview the title names the strongest tissue, such as Fibroblast of Arm. Lists all four alleles, with < cutoff and reference allele, to 6 decimals
differences.proposed: Title is the row, such as alimentary canal. Lists scored alleles and the reference, to 3 decimals, and marks the strongest. The strongest tissue is not named
differences.evidence: Hovered cells on both sides. The hint naming it is replaced by the link: packages/ui/src/Tooltip/DataTooltip.tsx:12

differences.existing: Help button opens a dialog explaining the tooltip
differences.proposed: No help dialog

differences.existing: Continuous blue to red, -1.0 to 1.0, titled Expression Effect
differences.proposed: Seven steps with edges at 0.1, 0.3 and 1, titled Expression effect, log fold change, with Decreases and Increases expression

differences.existing: ExPectoHeatmap.tsv; first column Tissue; values carry the allele, such as T:0.135563
differences.proposed: pten_expecto_tissue_systems.tsv; first column row; headers carry the reference base, values are bare numbers, so the scored allele is lost

differences.existing: URL stays /expecto/gene/5728 whatever the view
differences.proposed: View, filters and search are kept in the URL, with a Copy link button

differences.existing: Scatter Plot and Table tabs; Plot style menu (Manhattan shown)
differences.proposed: Plot and a sortable variant list side by side; Plot by Genome position or Rank
differences.evidence: Capture pair 3. Other existing plot styles not checked

differences.existing: Heatmap and Tissues tabs; top 20 of 218 tissues; Reverse Sort; Full or Compact view; Search tissues
differences.proposed: Strongest effects, Heatmap and All tissues tabs; Resource filter; Show effects of, defaulting to 0.1 or more

differences.existing: Shows the top 20 tissues for chr3:12598855 G>A
differences.proposed: At 0.1 or more, chr3:12,598,855 G>A shows 0 tissues raised and none lowered, though 82 are weak
differences.evidence: Proposed job page. Ask: is 0.1 the right default, or should it start at All?
